THIS CRIMINAL APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS  DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 -2-  NC: 2026:KHC-D:4633-DB  CRL.A No. 100405 of 2022 HC-KAR CORAM: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.P.SANDESH  AND  THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE B. MURALIDHARA PAI  ORAL ORDER (PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.P.SANDESH)
Appellant counsel files a memo reporting the death of the appellant who died on 30.11.2025 while serving the sentence.

The counsel in support of this memo produced Medico-Legal Intimation to the Investigating Officer given by the Casualty Medical Officer, K.I.M.S. Hospital, Hubballi, wherein it is stated that the convict was admitted to the hospital on 15.09.2025 at 02.03 a.m. and he was passed away on 30.11.2025.
2.

The counsel in support of the said memo also produced the letter dated 30.11.2025 sent to the Investigating Officer by the Superintendent of Jail, Dharwad and also the letters are sent to the Human Rights Commission, Principal Secretary to the Home Department and also the Director of Prison, the learned Judge who passed the conviction order so also the Deputy Director General of the Prisons, Belgaum, and also the concerned Police station.
The counsel for the respondent No.1/State and also the counsel for respondent No.2 are present.

sentences.text: Having considered the memo and also the Medico- Legal Intimation as well as the letter of the Jail Superintendent who has reported the death to the concerned authorities, the appeal is abated as the appellant is no more.
5. The counsel appearing for the respondent No.2 brought to notice of this Court a recommendation was made by the concerned Judge invoking Section 357(A) of Cr.P.C., for grant of compensation.

Having considered the said submission, it is directed that if the compensation is not awarded in accordance with law, the respondent No.2 is directed to approach the trial Court seeking to pass an appropriate order invoking Section 357(A) of Cr.P.C., since it is a case of POCSO offences.
Sd/-
